731:t_017:2.en:
$n
「That's why the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ should be able to cancel out that power!」

731:t_017:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I see... So back then you learned your own role... that the $$いがみ合う双子$$ would become the core of the $$太極$$.」

731:t_017:6.en:
$n
「That kind of power isn't meant to be used... But if it lets me seal you away, then I...」

731:t_017:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But you're critically short on power!」

731:t_018:1.en:
$n
「Get out of here, Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll handle the rest on my own!」

731:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n! If the $$いがみ合う双子$$ can integrate $$スフィア$$s, then use our power too!」

731:t_019:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll seal $$アサキム$$ with our power!」

731:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's four $$スフィア$$s against four! We're not gonna lose, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_019:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Not enough! Even so, you can't surpass my infinite power!」

731:t_019:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「You can do it, can't you, $$ＡＧ$$? With the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!」

731:t_019:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Is this any time to hesitate? Let's do it!」

731:t_019:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood! $$エスター$$, please synchronize the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ with the $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

731:t_019:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「Roger! $n, I'm sending everyone's feelings to you!」

731:t_021:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Humans cannot become gods... We were never worthy of taking hold of eternity...」

731:t_022:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

731:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You denied the existence of the $$御使い$$s. Therefore, you must be punished.」

731:t_023:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「W-What are you doing!?」

731:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... You will live on forever within me.」

731:t_024:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$サクリファイ$$. Let me reward you for 120 million years of toil.」

731:t_025:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「One $$御使い$$... killed another $$御使い$$!?」

731:t_025:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Was it a lie, what they said about abandoning conflict!?」

731:t_025:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You bastard!」

731:t_025:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And we might have finally come to understand each other, damn it!」

731:t_025:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no business with you now.」

731:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A Reactor, in a single strike!?」

731:t_026:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This is bad! What he's after is...!」

731:t_027:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Did you kill $$サクリファイ$$?」

731:t_027:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is impossible to take the life of any $$御使い$$. You know that as well as anyone, $$アサキム$$.」

731:t_027:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「She will live on within me forever... And so will you.」

731:t_027:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n and the others did us a great service. They wore your power down this far.」

731:t_027:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Heh... You seem to have pushed yourself too hard. A natural result, for one who is no god.」

731:t_027:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$... You, too, have served me well until today.」

731:t_027:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That all twelve $$スフィア$$s gathered here on $$エス・テラン$$ owes much to your achievements.」

731:t_027:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「As expected of a supreme god from another world.」

731:t_027:12.en:
$$桂$$
「$$アサキム$$ is... a supreme god from another world...」

731:t_027:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To be precise, it is a system called $$シュロウガ$$.」

731:t_027:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Touching the $$アカシックレコード$$ and interfering with causality... That is the very essence of this $$シュロウガ$$.」

731:t_027:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why you possess the power to detect $$スフィア$$s, beings of the same nature, and the power to absorb them.」

731:t_027:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though I admit even I was surprised when you qualified as a Reactor.」

731:t_027:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The part that went missing from $$シュロウガ$$... and you, a mere substitute for it.」

731:t_027:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Through its power to distort causality, $$シュロウガ$$ exists with its counterparts from parallel worlds all overlapping at once.」

731:t_027:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In that sense, you are a being similar to $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who is with you people.」

731:t_027:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you knew about me as well...」

731:t_027:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It seems $$シュロウガ$$ didn't have its current form from the very beginning.」

731:t_027:24.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Through countless Destructions and Regenerations, the information of intelligent life was passed down...」

731:t_027:25.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It seems that by absorbing and converting the thoughts, memories and spiritual power of those with a special factor among them, it gradually transformed.」

731:t_027:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then what is the part that went missing from $$シュロウガ$$?」

731:t_027:27.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「An operator, so to speak. For the system called $$シュロウガ$$.」

731:t_027:28.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Judging from the interface, it must be something in human form, but...」

731:t_027:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「When $$シュロウガ$$ drifted into our world, no one was aboard it.」

731:t_027:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So $$シュロウガ$$ created the missing part by itself...」

731:t_027:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... That is you.」

731:t_027:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though whether you are the same as the original, I cannot say.」

731:t_027:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You must have felt the emptiness within yourself as well. Though you probably kept denying it.」

731:t_027:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And $$ドクトリン$$ analyzed part of the $$シュロウガ$$ system and set it to infinite reincarnation... in other words, immortality.」
